turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_block) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*)

turns.sent: PMAY-G houses completed for 22-23 in Gasuapara block, South Garo Hills
turns.answer: Completed houses in Gasuapara block, of the houses sanctioned in FY 2022-23: 147. This is the PMAY-G figure.
chips: How many PMAY-G houses have been sanctioned in Gasuapara block, South Garo Hills?
Break that down by village within Gasuapara block.
turns.rewritten: How many PMAY-G houses were completed in Gasuapara block, South Garo Hills in FY 2022-23?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  UPPER(lgd_block) AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*)
